subject: Banking
title: Collateral and Secured Lending
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Collateral and Secured Lending.

hook.text: A mortgage is cheap because the bank can take your house.

buildup.text: Collateral reduces lender risk. If you default, the bank sells the asset to recover its money.

discovery.text: Homes, cars, and savings accounts can all serve as collateral. The better the collateral, the lower the interest rate.

twist.text: In a crash, the asset securing the loan can sink below the debt and expose both sides.

climax.text: Collateral makes lending safer until the collateral's value drops.

punchline.text: Your house secures the mortgage. If home values drop, the safety disappears.

quiz.question: Why do mortgages have lower interest rates than personal loans?
options: The home serves as collateral the bank can seize
